title: Enterprise Multimodal Document Parsing, OCR & RAG Ingestion Platform Selection

tiers.tier: Tier 1: Basic CPU Rule-Based PDF Text Extraction (`PyMuPDF / pypdf / Naive Chunking`)
tiers.architecture: Raw text stream extraction on CPU without layout analysis, table structure recovery, or OCR

tiers.tier: Tier 2: 100% Cloud-Managed Document AI API (`Azure AI Document Intelligence Layout / AWS Textract`)
tiers.architecture: Sending every single page (including simple plain-text pages) through per-page cloud OCR + table API

tiers.tier: Tier 3: 100% Frontier VLM Page-by-Page Rendering (`GPT-4o / Claude 3.5 Sonnet Vision` on Every Page)
tiers.architecture: Rasterizing all 15M pages/month to 300 DPI PNGs and calling a frontier VLM on every page

tiers.tier: Tier 4: Complexity-Routed Hybrid Ingestion (`PyMuPDF` Fast-Path + GPU `Docling/MinerU` + Selective VLM / Cloud Doc AI)
tiers.architecture: Page Complexity Classifier routes 55% born-digital text to CPU Fast-Path, 35% complex tables/scans to L40S GPU `Docling/MinerU` (or Azure Doc Intelligence), and only 10% dense charts/diagrams to VLM

scenarios.scenario: Multi-Column Financial PDFs & Cross-Page Merged Header Tables
scenarios.question: A 200-page annual report contains 2-column prose and financial tables spanning 3 pages with merged row/column headers
scenarios.model_answer: Route table/multi-column pages to Layout-Aware Parser (`Docling / MinerU` on L40S GPU or `Azure Document Intelligence Layout`) emitting structured Markdown/HTML tables with parent-header propagation (96.4% RAG accuracy)
scenarios.tier1_3_failure: Tier 1 `pypdf/PyMuPDF` reads across columns horizontally and scrambles table cells into unparseable number soup (48.5% accuracy).

scenarios.scenario: Avoiding the $150K–$278K/Month Bill on 15 Million Pages/Month Bulk Ingestion
scenarios.question: Enterprise ingests 15M PDF pages/month: 55% are simple single-column born-digital text, 35% have tables/scans, and 10% contain architecture diagrams or financial charts
scenarios.model_answer: Lightweight Page Complexity Router (`< 2ms/page`) inspects PDF object stream: routes 55% simple text to CPU (`$0.15/1K pages`), 35% tables to GPU `Docling/MinerU` (`$1.80/1K`), and only 10% chart pages to VLM (`$16/1K`) -> blended `$2.40 / 1,000 pages` (`$36K/mo` total)
scenarios.tier1_3_failure: Tier 2 pays $10/1K pages on all 15M pages ($156K/mo); Tier 3 pays $18.50/1K pages rasterizing plain text for a frontier VLM ($278K/mo).

scenarios.scenario: Extracting Architecture Diagrams, Bar Charts & Handwritten Annotations for Multimodal RAG
scenarios.question: Engineering and equity research PDFs embed vector/bitmap charts where the numbers only appear visually inside the graphic
scenarios.model_answer: Layout detector crops figure bounding boxes and sends only cropped chart/diagram regions to a Vision-Language Model (`Qwen2.5-VL / GPT-4o / Azure Content Understanding`) to generate structured JSON data tables + semantic captions (95.2% chart QA recall)
scenarios.tier1_3_failure: Tier 1 (`12.0%` recall) and standard OCR Tier 2 (`54.0%` recall) miss axis relationships, legends, and visual trends inside charts.

scenarios.scenario: Bounding-Box Citation Grounding (`page_no + bbox`) for Regulated Audit Verification
scenarios.question: Legal and compliance officers require clicking any number in the RAG answer to highlight the exact table cell on the original PDF page
scenarios.model_answer: Preserve element-level `[page, x0, y0, x1, y1]` bounding-box coordinates from `Docling / Azure Document Intelligence` inside the vector chunk metadata so the UI highlights the exact source cell
scenarios.tier1_3_failure: Tier 3 full-page VLM transcription loses exact pixel bounding-box coordinates for individual cells and hallucinates numbers on dense 12-column tables.

perturbation_checks.check: Scanned 200-DPI Skewed / Stamped Legacy Contract Batch (30% of Daily Volume)
perturbation_checks.perturbed: 95.6% Accuracy (Deskew + GPU `MinerU / Azure Doc Intelligence` OCR Fallback)

perturbation_checks.check: Hierarchical Section-Aware Chunking vs. Fixed 512-Token Sliding Window
perturbation_checks.perturbed: 96.4% Accuracy (Never splits a Markdown/HTML table across chunk without repeating `<thead>` column headers)

key_findings: Tier 4 (Page-Complexity Router -> 55% CPU Fast-Path + 35% GPU Docling/MinerU or Cloud Layout API + 10% Cropped-Figure VLM) achieves 96.4% table/layout RAG accuracy and 95.2% chart QA recall at $2.40 per 1,000 pages ($36K/mo vs $156K–$278K/mo).
Sending 100% of pages to a frontier VLM (Tier 3) or per-page Cloud OCR API (Tier 2) wastes 55%–85% of budget on simple born-digital text pages that CPU parsers extract in <2ms.
Repeating `<thead>` column headers on every split chunk of a multi-page table and attaching `[page, x0, y0, x1, y1]` bounding boxes prevents context-free number chunks in vector search.
